_comment: Virtual devices: drawn or driven by DCS Signal Converter itself, with no maker's hardware behind them.

_notes: Not hardware: the MCDU's text grid drawn in a web page, for anyone without a CDU. The page is a file, kneeboard-cdu.html beside the settings, opened in OpenKneeboard or a browser on this PC (crates/dsc-config/src/web.rs); the converter answers it with the screen on 127.0.0.1:8310 once a profile turns the device on. See crates/dsc-cli/src/panels/web.rs.

One lamp, the screen backlight, which the page draws by fading the screen towards black. Not the MCDU's lamps, so it is not a variant of the MCDU and nothing can follow it or be followed by it. Its slots are its own.
Its keys are the keyboard's 1 to 6, held with the page modifier, since the page has no keys a user in VR could press.
